# Roblox Pal Hair

`pal_hair.mesh` and `pal_hair.png` are Roblox's own free "Pal Hair" (catalog item 63690008, by Roblox), downloaded unchanged from assetdelivery.roblox.com.

They're used only in marketing renders (the game icon), so the courier wears the hair Roblox players recognise. In game, players wear their own avatars.

`marketing/courier.py` (`pal_hair`) seats it the way Roblox does, using the scale and attachment offsets read from the accessory file.
